Passenger · United States

Passengers and crew of Flight 93

United Airlines Flight 932001
Flight
United Airlines Flight 93
Date
11 September 2001
Aircraft
Boeing 757-200
Location
Shanksville, Pennsylvania

On September 11, passengers and crew fought back against the hijackers. The aircraft crashed near Shanksville, Pennsylvania, short of its intended target.

Who helped

  • Todd Beamer PassengerTold an Airfone operator that he and other passengers planned to jump a hijacker, and was heard saying "Are you guys ready? Okay. Let's roll."Sources: 1 2 3 4
  • Tom Burnett PassengerCalled his wife several times with details of the hijacking and told her that a group of passengers was planning to take back the plane.Sources: 1 2 3 4
  • Jeremy Glick PassengerTold his wife by phone that the passengers had voted on rushing the hijackers and that he and other men were organising to do it.Sources: 1 2 3 4 5
  • Sandy Bradshaw Flight attendantReported the hijacking to United, then told her husband she and others were boiling water to throw at the hijackers before running to first class.Sources: 1 2 3 4 5

Source: en.wikipedia.org/wiki/United_Airlines_Flight_93 ↗
